ctx.x: And the last band there, the fellas died on the corner. They had a band and they had breakups right there. They was going down to St. Claude Street. And the cut up fell up too bad there. And so they know them. They take it three blocks and then they dismiss them. You know, but you can't carry them directly to the grave. While they bury them, the band be playing. Then on the way back, but them was old days. They were down. Too ratty. They cut up one another.
I don't want to break Jim Horner that day. Is that right? Yeah, right there in the block. Howard?
